questions.prompt: Describe the ocean in exactly 12 words. Do not use the letter 'e' anywhere in your reply.
questions.reference: Vast salty liquid mass rolling across our world, calm and stormy always.

questions.prompt: Write exactly 3 sentences about dogs. Use only lowercase letters. The very last word of your reply must be 'woof'.
questions.reference: dogs are loyal friends. they love to run and play outside. every happy dog says woof.

questions.prompt: Invent a fictional student. Reply with only a raw JSON object (no code fences, no extra text) that has exactly these three keys: "name" (a string), "age" (a whole number), and "hobbies" (a list of exactly 3 strings).
Write a poem about nature that is exactly 7 lines long. The first letters of the lines, read from top to bottom, must spell CHARLIE. Do not add a title.
questions.reference:
Calm winds drift over hills
Hollow trees hum softly
A river bends below
Rain taps on old stone
Light fades into dusk
Insects sing at night
Evening settles in

questions.prompt: List exactly 5 different fruits, one per line, in alphabetical order. Do not use numbers, bullets, or any other text.
Explain what a benchmark is in exactly 2 sentences. You must use the word 'yardstick'. You must not use the words 'test', 'measure', or 'score'.
questions.reference: A benchmark is a shared yardstick that lets people compare different systems fairly. Everyone runs the same tasks so the results can be lined up side by side.
